newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Nov wholesale prices up 2.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Thai Nov wholesale prices up 2.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Thai wholesale price index (WPI) rose 2.5 percent year-on-year in November against a 3.5 percent increase in October, a Commerce Ministry official said on Wednesday.
Wholesale prices decreased 0.8 percent in November from October against a 0.9 percent month-on-month increase in October, the official told Reuters.
The 1985-based index rose to 156.2 in November from its 152.4 level in November 1995.
